notes.title: Patch Notes for 2023-10-14
notes.notes:
Green With Energy has been updated with the following changes.

[b]User interface[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new tooltips when hovering over different tools (thanks Filip [url=https://discord.gg/xVfV2QPjxq]from the Discord server[/url] for the suggestion):

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34064981/5da59abcc9af6bb0db5d8652ba3ca7ea1d91b437.png[/img]
[*] Added fun speech bubbles to buildings when power is cut

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34064981/6a8befbbec13d0628c1cc45ae31327a370fc251b.png[/img]
[*] Doubled the UI scale range to better support 4K displays (thank you ThePiachu for reporting)
[*] Updated the look and feel of UI dropdowns
[/list]
[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new music track
[*] Updated localization strings with latest translations
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 2023-09-19
notes.notes:
Green With Energy has been updated with the following changes.

[b]User Interface[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix bug where the active tool wasn’t properly highlighted (thank you for the feedback!)
[*] Add right-click to go back in certain tools (everything except Power Lines which already uses right-click)
[*] Add tooltips for top icons showing keybindings (shown below)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34064981/f14c8facf01b9c61c4744266a07fe9a5c498c9f6.png[/img]

Happy engineering!
The Green With Energy Team
